$comment: Content schema for the x-thread template (ws5, integration R8). The page renders from this object: <slug>.content.json .content and the in-file island <script type="application/json" data-vpk-content="x-thread"> hold the same value. Runtime state (approvals, intents, posted links, image bytes) never goes here; it lives in the data-vpk-x-thread-state island and in the browser. Post ids are stable review anchors (xtpost<n>), so splits may mint them out of order.

title.$comment: The page heading. Agent-owned: the browser never edits it.

handle.$comment: The posting account. A pasted post link from another handle gets a warning.

text.$comment: Post text exactly as it should go out. Do not add 3/6 numbering; X counts it.

alt.$comment: Alt text. Without asset, it describes the screenshot still needed: the page shows a [DATA NEEDED: image · <alt>] slot.

asset.$comment: Path relative to the folder of <slug>.content.json, for example media/p2-1.png. No absolute paths and no parent segments. fill inlines the bytes.

note.$comment: Agent note shown under the post, never posted.
